switch costume to (drone v)
if <touching (Pads v)?> then
  judge landing :: custom
else
  if <touching (Ground v)?> then
    set [state v] to [crash]
  end
end
if <not <(state) = [flying]>> then
  broadcast (round over v)
end

define judge landing
set [mult v] to (0)
set [i v] to (1)
repeat (length of [padLeft v])
  if <<(posX) > (item (i) of [padLeft v])> and <(posX) < (item (i) of [padRight v])>> then
    set [mult v] to (item (i) of [padMult v])
  end
  change [i v] by (1)
end
if <<<(mult) = (0)> or <([abs v] of (angle)) > (12)>> or <([abs v] of (Drift)) > (10)>> then
  set [state v] to [crash]
else
  if <(Descent) < (10)> then
    set [state v] to [good]
  else
    if <(Descent) < (18)> then
      set [state v] to [hard]
    else
      set [state v] to [crash]
    end
  end
end

define show flame
if <<(state) = [flying]> and <(force) > (0)>> then
  if <(force) < (0.04)> then
    switch costume to (drone-flame v)
  else
    switch costume to (drone-boost v)
  end
end
